_provenance: Real capture: POST https://rettfrabonden.com/a2a against a live production agent found via a2aregistry.org, 2026-07-07. Puts "artifacts" as a sibling of the nested "task" wrapper -- {result: {task: {...}, artifacts: [...]}} -- rather than inside it like every other v1.0-nested-task agent tested. Before _task_from_result() merged the sibling artifacts in, deterministic extraction found nothing, silently fell through to the (slower, costlier) LLM content-extraction fallback for content that was right there one level up -- and in the live run, that fallback call itself hit a separate rare edge case (empty LLM response content) that crashed with a raw 'list index out of range'. Trimmed to 1 of 20 agent results for fixture brevity.
